svg.aria-label: Runs passed and wall time per run of each agent, a panel per task. Each bar is the median wall time with the median time in hyprmasq's tools inside it, and each dot one run. Each row also gives its runs passed.
svg.title: Runs passed and wall time per run of each agent, a panel per task. Each bar is the median wall time with the median time in hyprmasq's tools inside it, and each dot one run. Each row also gives its runs passed.
svg.text: Each row gives the runs passed and the median wall time. In its bar, the blue part is the median time
in hyprmasq's MCP tools, and the grey part fills it up to the median wall time. Each dot is one run.
Each panel's scale fits most models: a slower model's bar is cut at its edge, and its runs stand past it.
Kimi K3.1 Pro asked for high effort and ran at max.
